name: SNAPSHOT + DECISION WRITER v2.0
BUILD SQL (last 24h) — v3 UTC / stable zones
func:
msg.topic = "-- Candidate for BUILD SQL v3, MariaDB 10.11. Not deployed.
-- Legacy snap_* timestamps are confirmed UTC; format explicitly for JavaScript.
WITH
samples AS (
 SELECT id,ts,room,temp,humidity,online
 FROM nodered_db.snap_sensors_th
 WHERE ts>=UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ts<=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
),
heating AS (
 SELECT id,ts,relay_name,state,
 CASE
  WHEN relay_name='Nappali fűtéskör' THEN 'nappali'
  WHEN relay_name='Hálószoba fűtéskör' THEN 'halo'
  WHEN relay_name IN ('Gyerekszoba fűtéskör','Gyerekszoba fűtéskör') THEN 'gyerek'
  WHEN relay_name='Fürdőszoba fűtéskör' THEN 'furdo'
  WHEN relay_name='WC fűtéskör' THEN 'wc'
  WHEN relay_name IN ('Kazán','Kazán On/Off') THEN 'kazan'
  WHEN relay_name IN ('Szivattyú','Szivattyú On/Off') THEN 'szivattyu'
  ELSE NULL
 END AS relay_key
 FROM nodered_db.snap_heating
 WHERE ts>=UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 1 DAY-INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
   AND ts<=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
),
zone_matches AS (
 SELECT s.id AS sensor_id,h.ts AS relay_ts,h.state,h.relay_name,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY h.ts DESC,h.id DESC) AS rn
 FROM samples s LEFT JOIN heating h
 ON h.relay_key=s.room AND h.ts<=s.ts AND h.ts>=s.ts-INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
),
boiler_matches AS (
 SELECT s.id AS sensor_id,h.ts AS relay_ts,h.state,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY h.ts DESC,h.id DESC) AS rn
 FROM samples s LEFT JOIN heating h
 ON h.relay_key='kazan' AND h.ts<=s.ts AND h.ts>=s.ts-INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
),
weather_matches AS (
 SELECT s.id AS sensor_id,w.ts AS weather_ts,w.temp,w.humidity,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY w.ts DESC,w.id DESC) AS rn
 FROM samples s LEFT JOIN nodered_db.snap_weather w
 ON w.ts>=UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 1 DAY-INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
 AND w.ts<=s.ts AND w.ts>=s.ts-INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.ts,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS timestamp,
 s.room AS zone_key,
 CASE s.room
  WHEN 'nappali' THEN 'Nappali T&H'
  WHEN 'halo' THEN 'Hálószoba T&H'
  WHEN 'gyerek' THEN 'Gyerekszoba T&H'
  WHEN 'furdo' THEN 'Fürdőszoba T&H'
  WHEN 'wc' THEN 'WC T&H'
  ELSE s.room END AS room_name,
 CASE WHEN s.online=1 THEN s.temp ELSE NULL END AS indoor_temp,
 CASE WHEN s.online=1 THEN s.humidity ELSE NULL END AS indoor_hum,
 s.online AS sensor_online,
 CASE WHEN z.state IN (0,1) THEN z.state ELSE NULL END AS relay_state,
 z.relay_name,
 TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,z.relay_ts,s.ts) AS relay_age_seconds,
 w.temp AS outdoor_temp,w.humidity AS outdoor_hum,
 TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,w.weather_ts,s.ts) AS weather_age_seconds,
 CASE WHEN b.state IN (0,1) THEN b.state ELSE NULL END AS boiler_state,
 TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,b.relay_ts,s.ts) AS boiler_age_seconds
FROM samples s
LEFT JOIN zone_matches z ON z.sensor_id=s.id AND z.rn=1
LEFT JOIN boiler_matches b ON b.sensor_id=s.id AND b.rn=1
LEFT JOIN weather_matches w ON w.sensor_id=s.id AND w.rn=1
ORDER BY s.ts DESC,s.id DESC;
";
return msg;
